name: Inquisition learns Saber Slash at 10 and it generates rage (#7194)
contract: Saber Slash (Fire) 680230 is the Inquisition (spec 12) melee generator: SpellFamily 21, melee weapon spell (effect 121 plus triggers 802842 Fiery Judgement and 802007 Wrangler's Net), but its DBC family flags [0,0x10,0] carry no Heartseeking bit and no grant or script binding referenced it. The server teaches it at 10 through the spec-12 taught ability gated on the Flames of Sin identity 92094, binds it to spell_ascension_witch_hunter_ability, and converts damage dealt into rage by spell ID (flag-based matching would also retarget its EFFECT_2 trigger to 807316 in ApplyContracts). The level-10 Inquisitor therefore knows the spell after picking the spec, and a landed cast builds rage.

steps.label: Let login and level scaling settle
Inquisitor knows Saber Slash after picking the spec at 10
SETUP: the Witch Hunter has a Rage pool
Let the weapon swap cooldown expire
Saber Slash lands on the target
